_comment: Hand-authored audio (master plan Phase 12). No sound files exist yet (plan §13), so 'sounds' is empty and every event is silent. Adding a sound is a data change: an entry in 'sounds' pointing at a file under res://assets/runtime/audio/ and its bus. 'events' says which sound plays for what: behaviour states ('state:<name>'), bone changes, and 'ui_click' for any button. Volumes are 0-1 and saved per player; whether an overlay starts muted is the client's decision (plan §14).
